summary: Slam Corp., a Cayman-incorporated SPAC trading on the OTC Expert Market, filed an 8-K disclosing an October 1, 2026 Amended and Restated Consolidated Promissory Note issued to Slam Sponsor, LLC, consolidating ten prior notes dated November 30, 2021 through May 15, 2025. Principal is $15,514,982, matching amounts already funded, so no new borrowing occurred; undrawn commitments were terminated. The note now bears non-compounding Wall Street Journal prime interest, matures in five years, and is forgiven on liquidation, with the sponsor waiving trust-account claims. It is share-settleable and prepayable at par.
